name: rac4/pal
about: Gladiator, PAL (SCES_532.85), by US catalogue name mapped to the PAL function by config/pal/map.tsv: tools/cc.sh compiles a copy of the function's file with the candidate in place (SN GCC 2.95.3 v1.36 and the ps2eeas fix-up passes; the file's flags are its /* cflags: */ comment, read by tools/layout.py); tools/check_func.py is the checker. On macOS and Linux a `wine` shim runs the compiler through wibo, the way check_func.py runs it with wine on PATH.
flags: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'tools'); import layout; print(' '.join(layout.cflags(open(sys.argv[1]).read())))
notes: asm/pal/ comes from `python3 tools/asm_programs.py --version pal main frontbin ...` in rac4-decomp.
